Problem Statement:
Write a Java program to perform multiple subarray rotations on a given array based on the user's input. The user will input a series of commands, where each command specifies the starting index, ending index, and the number of positions to rotate the subarray to the right. Given an array of integers, you need to perform a sequence of rotations on specific subarrays. Each rotation command consists of three integers: the starting index start, the ending index end, and the number of positions k to rotate the subarray [start, end] to the right. 
Input Description:
The first line contains an integer n (size of the array). The second line contains n space-separated integers (elements of the array). The third line contains an integer m (number of rotation commands). The next m lines each contain three integers start, end, and k. 
Output Description:
Print the array after all the rotations have been performed. 
Sample Input:
8
1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8
2
0 3 1
2 5 2 
Sample Output:
4 1 5 6 2 3 7 8
